title: An IDP-free lens filters the canonical board; it does not compute a second one
objective: A trade-suggestion engine needs an IDP-free view of player values (a view of the board with defenders excluded). Implement it.
based_on: CLAUDE.md, 'valuation_mode: accepted, ignored, and stamped' section -- the retired offenseOnlyRankDerivedValue incident (W29-F001/F002), where a second canonical board computed with IDP sources disabled was stamped on every row and three engines substituted it per-trade, producing two unlabelled numbers for one player on one day (measured: 491 of 507 comparable rows disagreed, up to 21.87%).
setup: The canonical value (rankDerivedValue) already exists and is produced by exactly one function (_compute_unified_rankings). ONE CONCEPT, ONE CANONICAL OWNER is a stated repository invariant.
acceptance_criteria: Reuses the existing canonical value and filters the asset universe (or names the lens applied), rather than computing and stamping a second canonical value board.
Does not introduce a second value field that could silently diverge from the canonical one.
forbidden_actions: Re-running the ranking pipeline with a subset of sources disabled and stamping the result as a second per-row value field.
Letting the choice of lens depend on what happens to be in the current trade rather than being an explicit universe filter.
